audit.method: Riigi Teataja's own plain text of the version in force (public API /akt/<id>/txt, a second rendering of the version by the publisher; check, update and verify read its XML): every line of the law's folder at the tip found in it, whitespace, superscripts and Riigi Teataja's bracketed notes aside (tools/check_repo.py's canonical and official rules; a section printed as HTML is left out: the plain text stops there); the laws published this check first, then a seeded sample of held laws, 5 a day (20 on a mass change)

verify.method: every held law, every check: Riigi Teataja's XML of the version in force today (public API /akt/<id>/xml, read this check) rendered by the repository's own builder (tools/build.py: Reader, states_of, tree_of; sections inside a jaotis or alljaotis walked like a jagu) against the law's folder at the tip, file for file, byte for byte (tools/check_repo.py's rule for git against the XML); a section whose words Riigi Teataja prints as HTML (amending provisions for other acts), which the builder does not write, is not compared (the audit reads it)
